review_candidates.description: 【About BAMS 關於瑞鑑航太】 歡迎加入我們，一起定義未來的城市天空！瑞鑑航太科技股份有限公司（Bellwether Advanced Mobility Solutions, BAMS）為英國新創先驅 Bellwether Industries 的關係企業，專注於提供低空經濟與先進空中交通領域的系統解決方案。我們致力於建立台灣及全球城市低空交通產業鏈，投入高價值智慧系統開發，創造真正可複製的空中營運平台。我們的優勢在於卓越的軟硬體全端整合能力，以自主研發且整合 AI 技術的跨平台空中交通管理系統為核心，實現智慧航跡規劃與機隊協調。同時具備涵蓋隱藏式推進 eVTOL 原型機與多功能無人機系統的深厚硬體實力，藉此發展高適應性且可擴展的城市空中交通平台。 團隊匯聚了來自智慧移動、航太與軟體工程等領域的專業人才，始終秉持務實嚴謹的工程精神。我們深信專業紀律與開放平等的企業文化能夠完美並存，並致力於給予每位夥伴極大的彈性與不受限的成長空間。在這裡，你不僅僅是寫程式或做硬體，更是直接參與全球矚目的先進開發計畫。加入 Bellwether，與世界級團隊並肩作戰，在全球低空經濟版圖上締造屬於我們的技術標竿，共同完善未來的先進空中交通生態系！ Join us in shaping the future of urban airspace. Bellwether Advanced Mobility Solutions (BAMS), an affiliate of UK startup Bellwether Industries, is building the low-altitude transportation supply chain in Taiwan and globally, investing in high-value intelligent systems for a scalable aerial operations platform. Our edge is full-stack integration across software and hardware. At the core is a proprietary, AI-integrated cross-platform UTM system for flight path planning and fleet coordination, backed by hardware experience spanning concealed-propulsion eVTOL prototypes and multi-function drone systems. Our team draws on backgrounds in smart mobility, aerospace, and software engineering, with an engineering culture that's practical and exacting. We believe professional discipline and an open, flat structure can go hand in hand, and we give every team member real flexibility to grow. Here, you're not just writing code or building hardware. You're working on programs that draw international attention. Join Bellwether, work alongside a strong technical team, and help set the benchmark for low-altitude economy technology worldwide. 【Work Environment & Benefits 工作環境與福利】 我們創造一個敏捷且積極的工作環境，透過具挑戰性的工作與良性競爭提供自我成長的機會。 We create an agile and positive workspace, providing self-growth opportunities through challenging work and harmonious competition. 1. 國際化與海外人才支援 Global Talent & Relocation Support： 協助外籍同仁辦理工作許可及外僑居留證（ARC）申請。 Assistance with work permit and Alien Resident Certificate (ARC) applications. 提供住宿資訊、生活安頓與在地資源協助，幫助國際人才順利落地並融入台灣生活。 Practical relocation support, including housing information and local resources, to help international team members settle into life in Taiwan. 2. 工作文化 Work Culture： 扁平且開放的溝通文化，讓好的想法能直接被關鍵決策者聽見。 Open communication and direct access to decision-makers, allowing good ideas to be heard and acted upon. 提供彈性工時，並依職務性質安排部分遠端工作。我們重視成果、責任與團隊協作。 Flexible working hours and role-dependent hybrid work arrangements, with an emphasis on outcomes, ownership and collaboration. 我們的夥伴來自不同國家、文化、專業領域與生活背景。我們相信，多元經驗能帶來更好的判斷與創新，每位成員都能坦率表達觀點、受到尊重，並獲得公平的參與及成長機會。 Our team brings together people from different countries, cultures, disciplines and life experiences. We believe diverse perspectives lead to better decisions and stronger innovation. Everyone is encouraged to speak openly, treated with respect, and given a fair opportunity to contribute and grow. 3. 職涯與人脈發展 Career & Network Development： 有機會參與國際活動及講座，與業界直接交流。 Opportunities to attend international events and forums. 接觸新創生態圈的人脈與資源，一起把圈子做大。 Access to the startup ecosystem's network and resources. 4. 日常福利 Daily Perks: 專屬員工休息室，累了隨時可以喘口氣，零食吧、咖啡機隨你取用。 A dedicated employee lounge, stocked snacks, and a coffee machine to recharge whenever you need. 每月固定公司出遊或聚餐，生日當月專屬慶生。 Monthly company outings or team dinners, and birthday celebrations on us. 【You will need to 工作內容】 1. 設計並實作無人機嵌入式系統，整合邊緣運算（Edge AI）、機器學習晶片（Machine Learning Chip）、通訊模組與飛控系統之間的介面協作，確保整體系統穩定運作。 Design and implement UAV embedded systems by integrating interface coordination among edge computing (Edge AI), machine learning chips, communication modules, and flight control systems, ensuring stable overall system operation. 2. 與軟體及飛控團隊密切協作，負責無人機通訊協定、感測器資料融合與控制演算法的嵌入式實現 Collaborate closely with the software and flight control teams to implement communication protocols, sensor data fusion, and control algorithms on embedded systems. 3. 開發與優化嵌入式軟體與驅動程式，確保系統具備實時性能與穩定性。 Develop and optimize embedded software and drivers to ensure real-time performance and system stability. 4. 進行除錯、測試與驗證（含試飛），確保系統可靠運作。 Conduct debugging, validation, and flight trials to ensure reliable system operation. 【Qualifications We Require 必要條件】 1. 電機、電子、資工或相關科系畢業，具 2 年以上嵌入式系統開發經驗 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical, Electronic, or Computer Engineering, with at least 2 years of embedded systems development experience. 2. 熟悉 C/C++ 、Python、嵌入式 Linux，並具備基本硬體電路理解能力 Proficient in C/C++, Python, embedded Linux, and basic circuit-level understanding. 3. 熟悉即時作業系統（RTOS） Strong understanding of real-time operating systems. 4. 熟悉常見無人機感測模組（如 IMU、GPS、光流、ToF 等），並具備資料擷取、校正與整合應用經驗 Experienced with UAV sensor modules such as IMU, GPS, optical flow, and ToF, including data acquisition, calibration, and real-time fusion for flight control applications. 5. 熟悉版本控制系統 (Git) 與團隊開發流程 Familiar with Git and collaborative development workflows. 6. 熟悉通訊協定原理（UDP、UART、CAN、I2C 等） Strong understanding of communication protocols such as UDP, UART, CAN, or I2C 7. 熟悉任務排程、進程間通訊，以及多線程軟體架構 Familiarity with task scheduling, inter-process communication, and multi-threaded software architecture. 【Qualifications We Preferred 加分條件】 1. 熟悉 UAV平台、飛控演算法、或通訊協定 (MAVLink, PX4, ROS) Familiar with UAV platforms, flight control algorithms, or communication protocols (MAVLink, PX4, ROS). 2. 熟悉無線通訊協定（如 Wi-Fi、LoRa、5G、Mesh）或地面站通訊架構者尤佳 Knowledge of wireless communication protocols (Wi-Fi, LoRa, 5G, Mesh) or ground-station communication systems is a strong plus. 3. 具有無人機組裝、測試或實際飛行經驗 Hands-on experience with UAV assembly, testing, or flight operations. 4. 具 ROS 或基於 Linux 的輔助電腦開發經驗。 Experience with ROS or Linux-based companion computer development. 5. 有優良的中英文溝通能力 Excellent communication skills in both Mandarin and English 6. 能夠在快節奏且充滿挑戰的環境下安排任務之優先順序並實際執行 Ability to prioritize and execute tasks effectively in a fast-paced and challenging environment. 7. 具有團隊合作與注重細節的心態 With a teamwork attitude and a detail-oriented organized mindset.
